alerts.title: DTG-associated weight gain and hyperglycemia risk
alerts.message: Guidelines identify DTG as a drug associated with abnormal weight gain and hyperglycemia. The patient has gained 17kg (BMI increased from 25.6 to 32.4) and developed acanthosis nigricans since starting TLD (DTG-based regimen) 18 months ago. Current labs show pre-diabetes (fasting glucose 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.1%) and dyslipidemia. Evidence for drug attribution includes the temporal link to DTG initiation and guideline-cited associations. Evidence against includes modifiable risk factors like diet and exercise, and a family history of Type 2 Diabetes.

evidence.recommended_action: Screen for hyperglycemia risk factors per guideline algorithm; manage weight and metabolic parameters.

alerts.title: Missing hyperglycemia screening for high-risk patient
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend assessing for risk factors for diabetes mellitus before initiating ART or for patients on ART. The patient has multiple risk factors: age ≥30 years, family history of DM, BMI ≥25 kg/m² (now 32.4), and is on DTG. The algorithm indicates that with 2 or more risk factors, one should proceed to 'Check glucose*'. A structured screening and monitoring plan for this high-risk patient is not documented.

evidence.recommended_action: Formally assess DM risk factors using the screening tool and implement guideline-recommended glucose monitoring.
